faqs.question: What is a Solar Hybrid Inverter and how is it different from a regular on-grid or off-grid inverter?
faqs.answer: A solar hybrid inverter intelligently manages electricity from three sources simultaneously: solar panels, battery storage, and the utility grid. Unlike simple on-grid inverters that shut down during power cuts (anti-islanding), our SunMagic hybrid inverters continue powering your facility during grid failures without dropping your critical loads. Unlike simple off-grid inverters, they can synchronize with the grid and diesel generators to maximize savings and avoid battery over-cycling.

faqs.question: Can the SunMagic Hybrid Inverter run loads without any batteries connected?
faqs.answer: Yes! EnerTech’s SunMagic REeFI hybrid inverter features true batteryless operation. During sunny daylight hours, it can convert solar generation directly into AC electricity to run your household or commercial appliances, drawing from the grid only if cloud cover reduces solar yield. Batteries can be added at any later time.

faqs.question: What does "100% phase unbalance capacity" mean for 3-phase industrial inverters?
faqs.answer: Standard 3-phase solar inverters require balanced electrical loads across all three phases (R, Y, B); if one phase has heavy single-phase air conditioning while another is idle, standard inverters often trip on voltage unbalance. EnerTech’s 3-Phase SunMagic inverters feature independent phase regulation that safely supplies up to 100% unbalanced load on any single phase without voltage fluctuation or shutdowns.

faqs.question: How do solar hybrid systems synchronize with existing Diesel Generators (DG sets)?
faqs.answer: EnerTech hybrid inverters feature active DG governor integration with reverse-power prevention. When the diesel generator runs, the inverter dynamically throttles solar output so that solar power never pushes reverse electricity back into the generator (which would cause the DG alternator to trip or overheat), cutting fuel consumption by up to 70% during daytime outages.

faqs.question: Why should I choose Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) over conventional Lead Acid batteries?
faqs.answer: LiFePO4 batteries deliver more than 4,500 to 6,000 cycles (10 to 15 years of daily cycling) compared to just 1,000 to 1,200 cycles for lead-acid. They charge up to 3x faster, require zero maintenance or water topping, do not release acid fumes, take up 70% less floor space, and maintain constant voltage output throughout the entire discharge cycle.

faqs.question: What is the warranty and after-sales service policy provided by Electra Solar?
faqs.answer: Our flagship SunMagic solar hybrid inverters come with a 5-year manufacturer warranty backed directly by EnerTech’s Pune manufacturing facility. Electra Solar provides local field service, onsite troubleshooting, genuine spare parts, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) across Maharashtra and neighboring industrial corridors.
